items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jeff Levinson as the person who transcribed the music for the interviewee's group, but the interviewee (Dave Brubeck) does not mention Jeff Levinson directly or describe a personal relationship with him.

ctx.x: Neil called me up and said that the octet was the most quintessentially perfect group in jazz, it needed to be featured, and could we do it? I told him the story: we had no music, but we have a recording. He said, “But there’s a recording.” I said, “Yeah.” He said, “I know the perfect guy to transcribe it, Jeff Levinson.”
